title: Tell agents to link a ticket when they create it
description: Three texts mention how tickets are connected and need the new flags. In src/guide.js, the main topic has step 4 'Connect the plan' and the rules of thumb: say that a new ticket is linked in the same call with --blocked-by, --blocks or --relates, and that a ticket without any link should be a deliberate choice. In bin/plantool.js, the hint printed after ticket create ('Possibly related: ...') should name the flag form plantool ticket update KEY --relates OTHER next to plantool relation add. In README.md, add the flags to the quick start or the CLI section with one example. Keep the wording plain and short.
why: The flags only help if agents use them; the planning method must say so.

acceptance.text: plantool guide names the three flags
The hint after ticket create names plantool ticket update with --relates

todos.text: Update the guide text in src/guide.js
Run node --test (test/workflow.test.js checks parts of the briefing)

outcome.summary: Guide step 4 and a rule of thumb name --blocked-by, --blocks and --relates; the create hint names plantool ticket update KEY --relates OTHER; README quick start has one example.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test: 98 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped. plantool guide shows the new lines; a create with a possibly related ticket shows the new hint.
